evidence.source: Contract 209, the provider fixture lifecycle, applied to Production on 20 August 2026 by guarded rollout run 32341454128 from exact main be5a1fb569505e8a491565246bf848fa3a71f655, gated on encrypted backup 32339828989 and on exact-head rehearsal 32340787619 which PASSED. Every step of the rollout concluded success, its own postflight included. THE REHEARSAL IS THE PART WORTH READING. It dumped Production at 208, restored it into a disposable local Supabase, applied 209 to THAT COPY ONLY, and ran two behavioural suites against real Production data: 255_provider_fixture_lifecycle, which drives postponement, reschedule and reinstatement from decoded payloads rather than from any named club, and 171_ingestion_write_boundary, which asserts positively which functions may write a public relation unattended and refuses any it does not name. Production was never written during the rehearsal. EVERYTHING BELOW IS AN INDEPENDENT READ-ONLY QUERY AGAINST PRODUCTION taken at 2026-08-20T06:54:55Z, separately from the rollout. THE LEDGER HOLDS 209 ROWS AND NAMES 20260819200000 provider_fixture_lifecycle. THE MACHINERY ARRIVED INERT, WHICH IS THE REQUIRED OUTCOME AND NOT A DISAPPOINTMENT: predictor_internal.season_fixture_lifecycle_transitions exists with row level security ON and holds 0 rows, and SportMonks token 10 now resolves to kind postponed rather than unknown. A transition written during the apply would have meant the applier ran at migration time, which it must never do; it runs only from a consumed provider response. NOT ONE PLAYER-OWNED ROW MOVED, every figure matching the Contract-208 record: 1 auth user, 1 profile, 3 entries, 16 season predictions, 36 match predictions, 1 league, 1 league member and 578 season fixtures. Cron holds 11 jobs. ai.bets holds 230. THE FIXTURE STATUS HISTOGRAM WAS COMPARED WHOLE RATHER THAN BY TOTAL, in both the rehearsal and the rollout, because a migration that invented a postponement would leave season_fixtures unchanged at 578 while moving a fixture between statuses; it reads played 12, scheduled 566, before and after. EURO PUBLICATION REMAINS HIDDEN and BOTH PUBLICATION GATES REMAIN FALSE. THIS ROLLOUT SPENT NO PROVIDER CREDIT. WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO IS MAKE A POSTPONEMENT APPEAR. It makes one possible. The status moves when a provider response is next consumed under 209, and at the time of this record Production's SportMonks target polls on a 1440-minute cadence, last dispatched 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z, so the first consumption under this contract falls due 2026-08-20T23:45:00Z. That wait is the risk recorded as ING-006 and it is unchanged by this promotion.
